headings.scale: fluid text-4xl to text-6xl for Hero; text-2xl to text-4xl for Dashboard
headings.line_height: leading-tight for English, leading-snug (1.4) for Arabic
headings.letter_spacing: tracking-tight for English, tracking-normal (0) for Arabic. Arabic text MUST NOT use added letter-spacing.

body.scale: text-base (16px min for Arabic readability, prefer 18px for main content)

rtl_guidelines: Set dir='rtl' or 'ltr' dynamically at the HTML document level based on the selected language.
Use logical CSS properties in Tailwind exclusively: ms-, me-, ps-, pe-, border-s, border-e.
Set text-align: start; DO NOT hardcode text-left or text-right to ensure bidirectional mirroring.
Arabic text MUST NOT have added letter-spacing; it breaks cursive character connections.
Increase base Arabic font size (min 16px, prefer 18px) and line-height (1.7) for optimal legibility.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism for Sticky Headers (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#05050A]/60). True-gray flat surfaces for dashboard cards to reduce glare without heavy borders.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 'The Tracing Beam' (animated glow border) on active AI tool cards or Upgrade CTAs. Use subtle grid-borders (border-collapse style) for usage/history data.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Deep ambient shadows (shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(79,70,229,0.15)]) to create depth without relying on flat layers.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on the landing page background to eliminate digital flatness.

layouts.landing_page: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) for Features. Asymmetric, wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Hero section incorporates deep background and massive, fluid typography.
layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid. Persistent Sidebar on the inline-start side. Strict structural hierarchy, tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). Cardless or 1px subtle bordered widget containers.
layouts.chat_interface: Multi-turn layout mapped to logical start/end. Sidebar for historical sessions. Distinct user/AI conversation bubbles without harsh card edges.

components_instructions.sidebar: Responsive dashboard sidebar utilizing logical properties (border-e instead of border-r). Must contain: Dashboard, Chat, Text Gen, Image Gen, History, Settings, Upgrade Pro CTA.
components_instructions.usage_dashboard: Bento grid layout highlighting remaining credits (Free/Pro tiers) and usage history charts.
components_instructions.tools: Text Generation and Image Generation interfaces must prioritize content view (zoom in). High-contrast empty states.
components_instructions.language_switcher: Clear toggle (Arabic / English) in the header or sidebar to dynamically change the layout direction.
components_instructions.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp-edged. Apply interaction animations (e.g., slight scale down on active).
components_instructions.inputs: Highly customized Shadcn inputs. Explicit active/focus states with an accented border glow.

motion.hover: Hover state text/icon color must be a lighter hue than the active state. Use specific transitions (transition-colors, transition-transform), NEVER transition-all.
motion.loading: Use abstract glowing pulsing dots or skeleton screens rather than generic circular spinners to fit the AI aesthetic.
motion.page: Framer Motion staggered entrances for dashboard widgets and chat messages.

3d_libraries.use_case: Floating neural dust or abstract meshes on the Landing Page Hero background to establish an immersive AI vibe without overpowering the text.

media.image_constraints: Max overlay opacity bg-black/50. Mobile image height max 80vh.

testing.accessibility: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted in kebab-case (e.g., login-submit-button, language-switcher-toggle).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not center align the app container. Text reading flow must remain natural and start-aligned (text-start).
Use pre-existing Shadcn js components from src/components/ui when applicable. The workspace uses .js files, avoid .tsx code.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, structural transitions).
DO NOT use transparent dropdown backgrounds. Always provide a solid or heavy glassmorphism background (with blur) to prevent text collision over moving content.
Use 2-3x more spacing (padding/margin) than feels comfortable to achieve a premium look.
Always rely on logical CSS classes (e.g., ms-, ps-) for cross-directional RTL/LTR compatibility.
No emojis as icons. Use Lucide React or Phosphor Icons.
